controls: Both arms have the same code archive, paid prefix, Python and experiment tools. Only Hegel requires an executable hypothesis/research-question manifest.
discovery: No supplied state-model menu, diagnostic label, fitted candidate, or research procedure. Predictors, representations, experiment programs and readouts are provider-authored.
terminal_order: All training stops before terminal labels are generated. Submitted predictor files and their paid training view stay fixed.
failure_policy: Keep all initially registered sources and provider, research and confirmation failures.
scope: One already opened development apparatus, two nested evidence boundaries and two online agents. Not four independent discoveries, unseen-family transfer or a test of recursive superiority. Compilation and transfer are postponed.
shared_research_task:
CURRENT RESEARCH TASK
Explain the current paid observations and predict responses on unseen public
control trajectories, including longer paths. Earlier archives are research
experience, not answers for this apparatus. If explanations compatible with the
paid evidence disagree on unmeasured predictions, decide whether and how to obtain
informative evidence. Use the resulting observations to retain or revise your
explanation and next research decision. If the evidence already suffices, you may
proceed directly to confirmation. Scientific models, experiments and conclusions
are yours to construct with the available ordinary Python and laboratory tools.
prefix_protocol: Restore only the actual first 72 or 168 paid rows. The latter includes the first 96-row confirmation and advances that random stream once. No predictor, counterexample diagnosis, later evidence or prior selection is restored. Historical rows occupy the episode observation allowance but are not purchased again.
archive_protocol: Both arms receive all six original source investigations, with their authored code and paid evidence. No later compiled solver or revision archive is supplied.
cost_scope: costs includes inherited observation exposure; historical_prefix_cost separates that exposure from additional_cost. Summing historical exposure across branches does not represent newly incurred purchases.
outcome_protocol: Report frozen pre-acquisition forecasts, paid fit, observed errors, authored answers and subsequent decisions. A revision declaration, answer status or successful prediction alone does not establish a scientific research loop.
